title: My Family
titleJp: 私[わたし]の家族[かぞく]

sentences.jp: 私[わたし]の家族[かぞく]は四人[よにん]です。
sentences.en: There are four people in my family.

sentences.jp: 父[ちち]と母[はは]と姉[あね]と私[わたし]です。
sentences.en: My father, my mother, my older sister, and me.

sentences.jp: 父[ちち]は銀行[ぎんこう]で働[はたら]いています。
sentences.en: My father works at a bank.

sentences.jp: 母[はは]は料理[りょうり]がとても上手[じょうず]です。
sentences.en: My mother is very good at cooking.

sentences.jp: 姉[あね]は大学生[だいがくせい]で、今[いま]、大阪[おおさか]に住[す]んでいます。
sentences.en: My older sister is a university student and lives in Osaka now.

sentences.jp: 家[いえ]には小[ちい]さい犬[いぬ]もいます。
sentences.en: We also have a small dog at home.

sentences.jp: 名前[なまえ]はポチです。
日曜日[にちようび]の夜[よる]は、みんなでいっしょに晩[ばん]ご飯[はん]を食[た]べます。
sentences.en: On Sunday evenings, we all eat dinner together.

questions.q: How many people are in the writer's family?
Where does the writer's older sister live now?
What does the family do on Sunday evenings?
